subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should `doctor --fix` treat a missing primary `installPath` or `sourcePath` in the persisted plugin install index as stale state and remove that install record before rebuilding the registry?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive persisted-state repair: the code path is sound and proven, but the permanent behavior changes what `doctor --fix` does to existing upgraded user state.

options.title: Accept missing-path cleanup
options.body: Merge the PR after rebase/refresh, treating absent primary install paths as invalid stale records that doctor should remove.

options.title: Narrow the repair predicate
options.body: Ask for a narrower rule, such as limiting removal to configured official/npm records or adding extra reinstall-path handling before deleting records.

options.title: Pause for registry recovery design
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want a broader install-record recovery policy instead of a doctor-local cleanup.

recommendation.title: Accept missing-path cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge the PR after rebase/refresh, treating absent primary install paths as invalid stale records that doctor should remove.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent commits put this maintainer closest to the doctor plugin-registry and installed-index repair surfaces.
